reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports compliance: neither the Services clause (p0001) nor the Fees and Payment clause (p0023) imposes any most-favoured-nation or third-party-terms-matching obligation on Customer (AP), and the express non-exclusivity language confirms Customer remains free to deal with other agents and third parties on any terms.

The rule's preferred position is simply the absence of an MFN burden on Customer; the rationale correctly notes as a non-flagged observation that no Vendor-granted MFN exists in Customer's favour either, which is welcome-but-absent rather than a deviation.
No deterministic check failures and no over-flagging: nothing was redlined that benefits our party.
